lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, though spatial mapping is obscured by surface light caustics.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct shadow gradient below the linear crest.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A discrete cluster of approximately 8 high-luminance spots distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located in the lower and middle sections.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (Echeneidae family) attached to the dorsal fin apex and ventral-lateral regions.
